verdict.rationale: Checking the status of a filing or case is a fair question for a government tax service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no public status-lookup page. The only routes to one's own filings are the authenticated professional and personal spaces (Connexion à l'espace professionnel, Connexion à mon espace Finances publiques), plus phone or appointment contact. 'Vérifier un avis d'impôt' checks a tax notice, not the progress of the founder's own filing, application or case.
